question: Should this repository own a Windows-side recovery improvement, or should the root device-auth polling and expiry fix be routed to the bundled upstream OpenClaw CLI/gateway implementation?
rationale: Current documentation establishes that the gateway owns wizard state, while the observed transcript comes from the direct OpenClaw CLI; maintainer knowledge is needed to identify the authoritative implementation and avoid creating a second authentication path.

options.title: Reproduce and route the root fix
options.body: Reproduce both direct CLI and gateway-driven wizard authentication, then fix the authoritative polling state machine while keeping Windows recovery UI as a fallback.

options.title: Consolidate with the earlier report
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw-windows-node/issues/654 as canonical only if current reproduction proves that missed completion and expiry continuation share one root cause and one fix.

recommendation.title: Reproduce and route the root fix
recommendation.body: Reproduce both direct CLI and gateway-driven wizard authentication, then fix the authoritative polling state machine while keeping Windows recovery UI as a fallback.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the active provider-onboarding tracking scenario and explicitly restored this issue as a distinct work item.
